entries.head: hunt for

senses.en: to search for something actively

example.en: He's been hunting for a job since March.
example.zh: 他从三月开始找工作。

entries.l1_note: 找工作用 hunt for / look for；find 是找到。

entries.head: send in

senses.en: to send something to an organization

example.en: Send in your resume before the end of the month.
example.zh: 月底前把简历投出去。

entries.l1_note: 投递是 send in；send off 是寄走。

entries.head: step up

senses.en: to take more responsibility

example.en: Someone needs to step up and lead this project.
example.zh: 得有人站出来带这个项目。

entries.l1_note: 挺身是 step up；step in 是介入处理。

entries.head: let go

senses.en: to dismiss someone from a job

example.en: They let go of half the contractors.
example.zh: 他们辞掉了一半外包。

entries.l1_note: 解雇是 let someone go，比 fire 委婉。

entries.head: catch on

senses.en: to understand or learn quickly

example.en: She caught on to the system in a day.
example.zh: 她一天就上手了。

entries.l1_note: 上手是 catch on (to)；catch up 是赶上。

entries.head: brush up on

senses.en: to improve a skill you have not used

example.en: I should brush up on my English before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前我该把英语捡一捡。

entries.l1_note: 捡起来是 brush up on；不是“刷上去”。

entries.head: read up on

senses.en: to read a lot about a subject

example.en: Read up on the company before you go in.
example.zh: 面试前把公司资料查清楚。

entries.l1_note: 做功课是 read up on；read out 是念出来。

entries.head: bone up on

senses.en: to study something quickly before you need it

example.en: He boned up on SQL the night before.
example.zh: 他前一晚突击补了 SQL。

entries.l1_note: 突击补是 bone up on，美式老说法但还在用。

entries.head: polish up

senses.en: to improve something to a high standard

example.en: Polish up your resume before you send it.
example.zh: 简历发之前再打磨一下。

entries.l1_note: 打磨是 polish up；polish off 是吃光。

entries.head: turn down

senses.en: to refuse an offer

example.en: She turned down the offer because of the commute.
example.zh: 因为通勤太远她拒了那个 offer。

entries.l1_note: 拒绝是 turn down；turn up 是出现。

entries.head: think over

senses.en: to consider something before deciding

example.en: Take the weekend to think it over.
example.zh: 用周末好好考虑一下。

entries.l1_note: 考虑是 think over；think through 是把流程想清楚。

entries.head: mull over

senses.en: to think about something for a long time

example.en: I'm still mulling over whether to take it.
example.zh: 我还在琢磨要不要接。

entries.l1_note: 反复琢磨是 mull over，比 think over 更慢。

entries.head: weigh up

senses.en: to compare the pros and cons

example.en: Weigh up the salary against the commute.
example.zh: 把工资和通勤放一起权衡。

entries.l1_note: 权衡是 weigh up；weigh in 是发表意见。

entries.head: go after

senses.en: to try hard to get something

example.en: If you want that role, go after it.
example.zh: 想要那个岗位就去争取。

entries.l1_note: 争取是 go after；go for 是选择。

entries.head: hold out for

senses.en: to refuse an offer and wait for a better one

example.en: She held out for a higher salary and got it.
example.zh: 她坚持要更高工资，最后拿到了。

entries.l1_note: 坚持等是 hold out for；hold off 是暂缓。
collocations: hold out for a better offer

entries.head: settle for

senses.en: to accept less than you wanted

example.en: Don't settle for a job you'll hate.
example.zh: 别将就一份你会讨厌的工作。

entries.l1_note: 将就是 settle for；settle on 是选定。

entries.head: put in for

senses.en: to apply for a job or transfer

example.en: He put in for the team lead role.
example.zh: 他申请了组长岗位。

entries.l1_note: 申请内部岗位是 put in for；apply for 更泛。

entries.head: try for

senses.en: to attempt to get something

example.en: She's trying for a scholarship this year.
example.zh: 她今年想争取奖学金。

entries.l1_note: 争取是 try for；try out 是试用。

entries.head: apply yourself

senses.en: to work hard at something

example.en: If you apply yourself, you'll pass.
example.zh: 你用心的话能过。

entries.l1_note: 用心是 apply yourself；不是“申请自己”。

entries.head: sail through

senses.en: to pass easily

example.en: She sailed through the technical interview.
example.zh: 技术面她轻松过了。

entries.l1_note: 轻松通过是 sail through；scrape through 是勉强过。

entries.head: scrape through

senses.en: to pass with a very low score

example.en: He scraped through with 61.
example.zh: 他考了 61 分勉强过。

entries.l1_note: 勉强过是 scrape through；scrape by 是勉强过活。

entries.head: breeze through

senses.en: to finish something very easily

example.en: He breezed through the coding test.
example.zh: 编程测试他一下就做完了。

entries.l1_note: 轻松搞定是 breeze through；breeze 是微风。

entries.head: come through

senses.en: to do what you promised

example.en: The recruiter never came through with the offer letter.
example.zh: 招聘的人一直没把 offer 信发来。

entries.l1_note: 兑现是 come through (with)；也是“挺过来”。

entries.head: bring off

senses.en: to succeed in doing something difficult

example.en: She brought off a last-minute deal.
example.zh: 她在最后一刻把交易谈成了。

entries.l1_note: 办成是 bring off；bring up 是提出。

entries.head: carry off

senses.en: to succeed in something difficult

example.en: He carried off the presentation without notes.
example.zh: 他脱稿把汇报做得很漂亮。

entries.l1_note: 出色完成是 carry off；carry out 是执行。

entries.head: pan out

senses.en: to end in a particular way

example.en: The job didn't pan out, so I kept looking.
example.zh: 那份工作没成，我继续找。

entries.l1_note: 结果是 pan out，常带“没成”的语境。

entries.head: play out

senses.en: to develop in a particular way

example.en: Let's see how the negotiation plays out.
example.zh: 看看谈判怎么发展。

entries.l1_note: 发展是 play out；play off 是挑拨。

entries.head: turn out

senses.en: to happen in the end

example.en: The interview turned out to be a group session.
example.zh: 面试最后是个群面。

entries.l1_note: 结果是 turn out；turn up 是出现。

entries.head: crop up

senses.en: to appear unexpectedly

example.en: A better opening cropped up two weeks later.
example.zh: 两周后突然出现一个更好的机会。

entries.l1_note: 冒出来是 crop up，多指问题或机会。

entries.head: live up to

senses.en: to be as good as people expected

example.en: The job didn't live up to the description.
example.zh: 这份工作和招聘描述不符。

entries.l1_note: 达到期望是 live up to；live on 是靠……过活。
